notes.title: 1.1 Game version update
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where players could not move after clicking on the breakfast bar. (The side quest will click the Breakfast shop again after completion, and the character will not be able to move.)

Repair planted plants can be harvested directly. (Plants do not need to be ripe to harvest fruit.)

Fixed a second hoe where the animated character could not move. (After the hoeing disappears, the character is unable to take action when hoeing again, and the animation continues.)

Added multiple map bars. (Add multiple map bars to keep dads from getting lost.)

Added the function of deleting files with one click on the home screen. (Good news for bad gear's dad)
